newsitem.title: USA: Eckerd sees Q3 oper net in line with views.
newsitem.headline: Eckerd sees Q3 oper net in line with views.

text.p: Eckerd Corp said on Wednesday that it expects its third quarter operating results to be in line with analysts' expectations.
Eckerd, a drug store chain, is expected by Wall Street analysts to earn $0.14 a share, according to First Call.
The company also said it reported sales of $1.3 billion, a 9.9 percent increase from the year ago period sales of $1.2 billion.
The company's operating earnings per share were $0.16, excluding a $5.0 million charge from the early retirement of debt.
Eckerd said its same-store sales for the quarter increased 7.4 percent and 8.4 percent for the nine month periods, including results from relocated stores that were open for less than a year.
